describe: Dark futuristic night scene: an indoor lab/room on the left with shelves, a globe and warm lamp light, a huge glowing purple-blue swirling energy portal in the centre standing on a neon ring platform, and a violet neon city skyline with towers and potted plants on the right under a starry sky. A curly-haired boy in a blue hoodie with a yellow backpack stands at lower left looking up at Nova, the white-and-blue robot with a glowing smiley face visor, who floats in front of the portal with one hand raised. The dark trust-bar panel at the bottom left is drawn semi-transparently over the boy's legs and shoe tops.
